answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake that unlocks only after a long record of verified work. Picture it as an ivory terrace: climbing in is easy to see, but each step costs real capital and time, so spinning up a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand stakes and doing a thousand honest jobs first. A public beacon of peer attestations then marks which identities have actually earned trust. The attacker pays linearly per fake identity while the reward for each stays small, so mass forgery stops being profitable.
